correctness.rationale: The two-stage reproductive kernel gives exact planar moment equations; a coercive damped-mechanical Lyapunov function forces convergence to one of three equilibria, and the characteristic formula lifts this to L1 convergence of the full age density.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source leaves threshold-solution asymptotics open and treats a different noncompact class. Classical linear-chain reduction is excluded from novelty; no located source states the resulting complete bistable threshold theorem for this boundary-feedback model. The inaccessible full text of a relevant 1979 Gurtin--MacCamy paper is retained as the main residual risk.

value.rationale: The result completely resolves the threshold limit and all omega-limits for an explicit infinite-support fertility family, showing that noncompact support alone does not permit persistent threshold oscillation when reproductive memory has two-stage phase-type structure.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
